name: Eyrie
tagline: Watches crowd camera feeds for dangerous density and movement and alerts staff before a crush.

awards: Best AI Application Built with Cloudflare

problem: Crowd crushes at festivals and events kill people before staff notice the build-up.
solution: YOLO detection counts people, estimates density and tracks movement from video; alerts go to staff on sudden congestion or unusual flow.
demo_moment: Team-described: a feed turns red as density rises and an alert fires.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best AI Application Built with Cloudflare” among 160 submissions.

lessons: Name a real tragedy the system would have warned about.
